config.illustrativeNote: Illustrative specifications and visual codes, not a real product catalog or certified ratings. All agents share the same model, nozzle and gauge; part details describe the base ABC model. Capacities use kg throughout this demo. Weight excludes the bracket.

saved.title: My configurations
saved.name: Configuration name
saved.nameHint: Enter a name of up to 60 characters. Matching names create separate saves.
saved.full: You have 10 saved configurations. Saving will replace the oldest: “{name}”. Cancel to keep all saves.
saved.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 60 characters, excluding spaces at the start and end.
saved.changed: Saved configurations have changed. Review the details and confirm again.
saved.invalid: Saved data is damaged or uses an unsupported format. It has been kept unchanged. Saving is paused; you can still configure the APAR.
saved.unavailable: Saving is not available in this browser. Check site storage permissions or free space and try again. You can still configure the APAR.
